data.exact_reserve_text: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and IBNR for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a favorable prior year development (release) of GBP 1.858 million, representing a 12.28% release of its opening gross reserves. This was primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years, as indicated by the claims development triangle. No specific causal factors or named events were identified for this movement.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.

Additional qualitative judgements are used to assess the extent to which past trends may not apply in the future, for example: once-off occurrence; changes in market factors such as public attitude to claiming: economic conditions: as well as internal factors such as portfolio mix, policy conditions and claims handling procedures.
Judgement is further used to assess the extent to which external factors such as judicial decisions and government legislation affect the estimates.
Other key circumstances affecting the reliability of assumptions include variation in interest rates, delays in settlement and changes in foreign currency rates.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle as no explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision' note or narrative was found. The claims development table only includes underwriting years up to 2022, so prior year development is calculated for 2019 and 2020 only.
